verdict_reason: The new helper duplicates escapeRegExp in type-ahead.ts, leaving one rule in two homes under two names.

todos.issue: escapeRegex duplicates the private escapeRegExp in page-objects/shared/type-ahead.ts:3 (same character class, same replacement), so the regex-escape rule now has two homes in page-objects/shared under two spellings of one concept (escapeRegex / escapeRegExp).
todos.fix: Must: one regex-escape helper in page-objects/shared, which type-ahead.ts and list-page.ts both import; the local copy in type-ahead.ts is deleted. One way: delete escapeRegExp from type-ahead.ts and import escapeRegex there, keeping the replaceAll + String.raw form the type-ahead copy already uses so Sonar's prefer-replaceAll and prefer-String.raw rules stay quiet.
